# Historical scene execution audit

**Scope and provenance.** All citations refer to expanded files under `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/scene_rsi_pilot/`. Their corresponding archive is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/r1--scene_rsi_pilot.tar.gz`; member paths are `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/scene_rsi_pilot/` plus the relative file paths cited below. No images were supplied for independent visual inspection.

## Kitchen corner: commons_133800864

The step-2 code constructs semantic assets from boxes, ellipsoids, rods, filleted boxes, sweeps and Boolean subtractions: window and 37 slats, upper cabinet, cut counter and sink, mounted paper roll, ring and towel, canisters, blender, jug and filter pitcher. The counter support height is coded as 0.80; that and the estimated reference bounds are design inputs, not measured contact or fidelity evidence [X0647, `C1/selection/commons_133800864/steps/002/build.py`, lines 5–14, 49–147, 149–267].

After realization, the script copies descendant mesh and material data, adjusts Principled metallic/roughness, and uses noise, color ramp and bump for stone and noise/bump for fabric. It sets a 40 mm camera at `(-1.105,-2.43,2.01)`, two area lights, world strength 0.30, and 384×512 Cycles/AgX output with 48 configured samples and denoising [X0647, same file, lines 271–360]. The task metadata also records a 384×512 reference, not a geometry measurement [X0651, `C1/selection/commons_133800864/task.json`, lines 2–5].

The step-3 script reports that step 2 still had an over-wide window, right-shifted roll, low-cropped sink and narrow towel; these are author observations, not independently verified findings. Its stated correction replaces the towel with seven gathered sweeps and wider lower panels while retaining the camera and lighting [X0649, `C1/selection/commons_133800864/steps/003/build.py`, lines 14–22, 198–235, 384–407].

Steps 1–3 each report `ok: true`, null error, empty stderr, a finished 16/16-sample render and saved PNG and blend file. The logged 16 samples differ from the 48 in the available build scripts; the reason is not recorded. This establishes completed renders, not image quality or physical attachment [X0646, `C1/selection/commons_133800864/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0648, `C1/selection/commons_133800864/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0650, `C1/selection/commons_133800864/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7]. No selection or acceptance record for this scene is supplied.

## Kitchen island: commons_138420790

The code models architecture, separate timbers, fitted cabinets and ovens, an island with drawers, Boolean-cut sink and swept tap, a boxed hood, and a ball-and-tube kettle. Its wood shader maps generated coordinates through anisotropic multiplication into noise, a brown ramp and bump; other owner materials receive copied roughness settings [X0658, `C1/selection/commons_138420790/steps/002/build.py`, lines 31–152, 154–205].

The first camera was `(-4.85,-4.35,2.18)`, lens 43. Following reported pale foreground occlusion and a hypothesis that the camera saw the wall exterior, step 2 moved it to `(-3.25,-4.40,2.18)`, lens 32. It configured four area emitters, 384×512 Cycles, 64 samples and AgX [X0656, `C1/selection/commons_138420790/steps/001/build.py`, lines 208–233; X0658, same step-2 file, lines 4–12, 207–236]. Both executions report success and saved renders, but each log records 16/16 samples, not the configured 64 [X0657, `C1/selection/commons_138420790/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0659, `C1/selection/commons_138420790/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7].

`selected.json` records step 2, although the separate record’s `selected` field is null. The record marks the run complete and valid, with overall 0.4253, SSIM 0.2505 and LPIPS 0.8232. Structure, material and composite checks passed, but explicitly measure edit operability; semantic completeness and support/collision truth are null. The functional check used CPU fallback because the authorized GPU became busy, not because a render failed [X0654, `C1/selection/commons_138420790/selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0653, `C1/selection/commons_138420790/record.json`, lines 16–34, 53–57, 132–146]. These scores and selection do not independently establish acceptable visual quality.

## Chaise: commons_109923183

The supplied C2 build is a lighting revision: it constructs a multi-part chaise, separate rotated pillow and card, room, curtain and cane chair; camera `(3.25,-6,3.65)` uses lens 64, while world/window/fill are set to 0.16/420/45. The author records two prior successful renders and residual framing and silhouette discrepancies, but this file is a static self-review and contains no result for the revision itself [X0661, `C2/development/commons_109923183/build.py`, lines 5–40, 59–154, 197–245]. No selection or acceptance is supplied. Across all scenes, ownership and coordinates alone do not prove contact, occlusion, or image fidelity.
